
## Download

**SingTogether-__VERSION__.dmg** below. Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or later), macOS 12 or later.

1. Open the disk image and drag SingTogether to Applications.
2. The app is not notarized, so macOS blocks it the first time. Allow it once:
   - **macOS 15 or later:** double-click the app, click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to *"SingTogether" was blocked* and click **Open Anyway**.
   - **macOS 14 or earlier:** right-click the app, choose **Open**, then **Open** again.
3. A ♪ icon appears in the menu bar.

Everything needed to read image and PDF scores is inside the app. For much better chords and lyrics, install and sign in to [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) or [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google); the app asks which one to use when it starts. Without one it uses Apple Vision, and nothing leaves your Mac.

See the [README](https://github.com/Jongwan93/SingTogether#readme) for everything it does.
